finding.cause: renew_controller checks stop/deadline only before original Store.heartbeat. After the last original guard, heartbeat can take time; final policy freshness checks DB cancellation but not worker.stop. Post-heartbeat local stop/time can otherwise be missed before guard returns.
finding.minimal_fix: After committed heartbeat/publication, recheck not worker.stop.is_set() and real time < same original deadline before continuation.
finding.evidence_type: Read actual WIP source; no dynamic reproduction or product execution

additional_scope_note: Known prior history branches return or reject before renew; a priorNone concurrent reservation race may perform heartbeat before CAS discovers duplicate, so all-race duplicate-zero-renew is not established.
